data.title: Spacecraft bound for Mercury faces 'tricky' arrival
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - A spacecraft carrying European and Japanese probes will complete an eight-year journey to arrive at Mercury on Thursday, while still facing high-risk manoeuvres to study the Sun-scorched planet.

data.title: In Ghana, larger-than-life coffins tell the stories of the dead
data.description: ACCRA - Frederick Teiko Ofori spent a large portion of his life with a guitar in his hands, so when the Ghanaian musician died in a road accident, his family decided that the instrument should accompany him on his final journey.

data.title: "Cockroach-free" Hokkaido faces rise in insects due to climate change
data.description: KYODO — Japan's northernmost main island of Hokkaido, long known for its reputation as being largely cockroach free, may begin to see more of the insects as factors including warmer temperatures spurred by climate change create ideal environments for cockroaches to thrive.

data.title: Families descend on Nepal in search of missing tourists
data.description: KATHMANDU (NEPAL) - Desperate families of missing foreigners were clinging to hope as they combed hospitals and morgues in search of clues, a week after catastrophic floods tore through Nepal's Himalayan border region.

data.title: Iran attacks US targets despite Trump threats
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran attacked US military bases in Kuwait on Thursday, despite President Donald Trump threatening further strikes in a fresh flare-up six months into the war.

data.title: Far-right AfD eyes huge win in east German state vote
data.description: BERLIN - Germany faces a landmark regional election Sunday in the ex-communist east where the far-right AfD is easily expected to win and has its sights on heading its first state government.

data.title: EU eyes Russia sanctions after drone ‘attack’ in Germany
data.description: WICKLOW, Ireland - The European Union (EU) on Wednesday said it had summoned Russia’s top diplomat as it eyed sanctions after a drone incident in Germany that the bloc’s foreign policy chief said bore the marks of “state-sponsored terrorism”.

data.title: Nepal seeks climate justice after Himalayan disaster
data.description: KATHMANDU - When a wall of icy debris from a glacial collapse on the China-Nepal border tore through his village last week, Pemba Chhring Tamang watched the landscape he had known all his life disappear.

data.title: Defence chiefs back bigger US military presence in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY - Washington and Canberra have agreed to boost the US military presence in Australia and speed up cooperation, both countries said on Thursday.

data.title: US not ‘stealing Venezuelan oil’, energy secretary insists
data.description: CARACAS - US Energy Secretary Chris Wright on Wednesday dismissed claims that Washington was “stealing Venezuelan oil” after the South American nation granted its northern neighbour access to a huge chunk of its natural resources.

data.title: Pacific states debate response to Chinese missile test
data.description: KOROR, Palau - The president of Palau called on Thursday for a “unified” Pacific response to July’s missile test by China on the final day of a summit clouded by allegations of meddling by Beijing.

data.title: Lake America? No way, Canadians say
data.description: OTTAWA - For Liam Mooney, Lake Ontario will always be Lake Ontario.

data.title: Tech bosses press G20 to build data centers, but split on risk
data.description: CHAPEL HILL (UNITED STATES) - Top US tech bosses, including Nvidia chief Jensen Huang and OpenAI's Sam Altman, urged G20 ministers Wednesday to embrace artificial intelligence and build the data centers to run it.

data.title: Trump 'happy' Prince Harry and Meghan have left US
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump said Wednesday he was glad Prince Harry and his wife Meghan Markle had left the United States -- while adding that if he were part of the British royal family, he would not have taken them back.

data.title: Rare train of Pacific cyclones fueled by historic El Nino
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Two powerful hurricanes and a strengthening tropical storm on Wednesday were churning through the Pacific Ocean where waters were being warmed by a historically strong El Nino climate episode.

data.title: EU summons Russia envoys, eyes sanctions after Germany drone 'attack'
data.description: WICKLOW (IRELAND) - EU countries on Wednesday summoned Russia's envoys and discussed fresh sanctions after a drone incident in Germany that the bloc's foreign policy chief said bore the marks of "state-sponsored terrorism".

data.title: Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz as 'Trump Strait'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump on Wednesday suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz as "Trump Strait," asserting US control of the vital waterway even as fighting raged there with Iran.

data.title: Uber says laying off 'about 10%' of workforce worldwide
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Ride-hailing giant Uber will be laying off around 10 percent of its staff as part of "significant organizational changes," CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said in a message to employees released on Wednesday.

data.title: Nicaraguan ‘reform’ bars opposition from elections
data.description: ⁠Nicaragua’s Congress ⁠has passed a constitutional ​reform that bans opposition parties from participating in elections and extends ​the presidential term from six to ‌seven years, a move that had previously drawn criticism from the United States and other countries in the region.

data.title: Tiger Woods forfeits driver’s licence for 5 years
data.description: Tiger Woods ​has given up his driver’s licence for five years under a plea agreement reached in connection with a car accident earlier this year in Florida.

data.title: Missing passengers ‘likely went down with sunken ferry’
data.description: ISTANBUL - The 20 people missing from a passenger ferry that capsized off northern Cyprus likely went down with the ship, officials said Wednesday as rescue operations continued for a fourth day.

data.title: Bus crash in Egypt’s Sinai region kills 22
data.description: CAIRO - A passenger bus overturned on a desert highway in Egypt’s eastern Sinai Peninsula on Wednesday, killing 22 people and injuring 28 others, authorities said.
